poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE ECHOES OF EVERY HAND THAT EVER HELD YOU,
poetryFrame.rightVertical: A MAP ETCHED IN SCARS, LEADING ONLY TO THIS QUIET PEACE.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: WE WERE FORGED IN THE FIRE OF WHAT WAS LOST
sonnetLines: A history written in the bone.
I learned to build my strength from you,
From seeds of sorrow widely sown.
No phantom ache can claim this core,
The lessons taught were sharp and true.
I walk a path I knew before,
But brighter now, defined by you.
Let the old ghosts whisper their refrain,
Their drama fades beneath the light.
A steady love washes out the stain,
And makes the darkness feel so bright.
The journey ends where comfort starts to bloom,
